faqs.q: What file formats do you accept for commercial printing projects?
faqs.a: We recommend submitting files in a high-resolution PDF format, but we also accept native files from common design programs such as Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop. Please inquire with us if you have a different file format, as we may still be able to accept it. Our team reviews all files and provides guidance on preparation to ensure optimal print quality.

In-house designers are available to create a design for you from conception or to refine layouts, optimize images, select appropriate paper stocks, and prepare files from artwork you supply to us. Whether you need minor adjustments or full creative support, our team handles every detail. Customer Service provides support on paper stocks, not the designers.

faqs.q: Can printed materials be mailed in-house?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Completed pieces move seamlessly into fulfillment, presort postage is applied and pieces are provided to USPS for delivery — all managed by the same concierge team. Not all mailing jobs are or can be done through the Postalocity platform.

faqs.q: What types of finishing options are available?
faqs.a: We provide folding, scoring, die-cutting, binding, perforating, UV coating, and other in-house finishing services. This ensures professional presentation whether producing brochures, business cards, forms, or marketing collateral.

faqs.q: How does the concierge model benefit commercial printing projects?
faqs.a: You have a single dedicated point of contact that oversees the entire workflow on your behalf — from file review through production, finishing, and optional mailing. This eliminates coordination across multiple vendors and helps your organization reclaim operational time weekly.
